messages:
maria: ACME EU invoice inv_2026_0432 failed - gateway code 484 (card country vs billing mismatch). VAT ID not present on token. Can ops + reconciliation look?
payments-bot: charge_failed invoice=inv_2026_0432 attempt=1 reason=card_country_mismatch gateway=stripe-eu bin_country=US billing_country=DE last4=4242
nora: Did checkout capture VAT? If not, we must request VAT ID before retry and place GL hold.
maria: Logs show tax_id empty. Customer says they were charged last month fine. They are on autopay.
ashley: Created ticket S-9123 https://zendesk.redwood/s/9123 asking for VAT ID and billing address. Pausing billing emails.
jon: Ops plan: (1) check with acquirer for geo-block, (2) if VAT ID arrives reattempt charge with metadata tax_id. If gateway rejects escalate to payments risk.
nora: Mark invoice "on hold - pending tax verification" and add reconciliation note. CC revenue.
maria: Propose 48h manual retry window for EU autopay to reduce churn.
jon: Auto-retry in 24h. If VAT ID arrives, payments will run manual retry: curl -X POST https://api.redwood/payments/retry -d '{"invoice_id":"inv_2026_0432","metadata":{"tax_id":"<VAT_ID>"}}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PAYMENT_OPS_TOKEN'
ashley: Updated ticket with instructions and requested VAT ID + company reg. docs.
payments-bot: Manual retry queued by jon for inv_2026_0432.
maria: If issuer blocks cross-border BIN and card can't be charged, finance should approve one-off wire for ~€12,400.
nora: Finance ok case-by-case. Submit wire PR via https://internal.redwood/finance/wires and cc finance@redwood.
jon: If wire chosen set invoice.payment_method=wire and status=pending_manual_payment, attach KYC and VAT.
maria: Next steps: support waits for VAT ID (ashley), ops checks acquirer and stands by for manual retry (jon), finance readies wire form if needed (nora). Following up in 24h. :thumbsup:
